premise: Squirrel buries her acorn friend in the ground for winter and forgets where; in spring Acorn has grown into a tiny tree.
inspiration: The seed-that-grows motif of The Little Red Hen and Jack's beans, turned: forgetting, not effort, is what plants the forest.
lesson: Small beginnings grow into big things, in their own time.
learning: Squirrels bury nuts and forget some, and those grow into trees

en-US.title: The Nut That Grew
en-US.text: {canvas:leaves 0.5 10s} In autumn, {squirrel:enter} Squirrel {squirrel:pulse} was busy, busy, busy. {squirrel:live} She nibbled a hazelnut, checked that nobody was watching, hid it behind her back… and hugged it. Then she dug a hole, {sfx:dig} scritch-scratch, and buried it for winter. {acorn:enter} Acorn {acorn:hop} watched. {acorn:face happy} [curious] Can you bury me too? she asked. I want to see what happens. {acorn:face sleeping} So Squirrel tucked Acorn into the soft ground. Pat, pat. {canvas:snow 0.5 9s} All winter, Squirrel dug up her nuts, one by one. But Acorn? {squirrel:wobble} [giggles] Squirrel forgot all about her. {canvas:sunshine 0.8 14s} Then spring came, and {bird:enter} Bird {bird:hop} sang. [gasps] Where Squirrel had forgotten, a tiny green {tree:enter} tree {acorn:sparkle} was poking out of the ground. {acorn:face happy} {squirrel:face surprised} It was Acorn! {tree:face happy} The old tree {tree:glow} rustled with pride. [softly] That's how I began, he said, a long, long time ago.

es-ES.title: La bellota que creció
es-ES.text: {canvas:leaves 0.5 10s} En otoño, {squirrel:enter} Ardilla {squirrel:pulse} estaba muy, muy ocupada. {squirrel:live} Mordisqueó una avellana, comprobó que nadie la miraba, la escondió detrás de la espalda… y la abrazó. Luego cavó un agujero, {sfx:dig} ras, ras, y la enterró para el invierno. {acorn:enter} Bellota {acorn:hop} la miraba. {acorn:face happy} [curious] ¿Me entierras a mí también?, preguntó. Quiero ver qué pasa. {acorn:face sleeping} Así que Ardilla arropó a Bellota en la tierra blandita. Pim, pam. {canvas:snow 0.5 9s} Todo el invierno, Ardilla fue desenterrando sus frutos, uno a uno. ¿Y Bellota? {squirrel:wobble} [giggles] Ardilla se olvidó de ella por completo. {canvas:sunshine 0.8 14s} Entonces llegó la primavera, y {bird:enter} Pájaro {bird:hop} cantó. [gasps] Justo donde Ardilla se había olvidado, un arbolito verde {acorn:sparkle} asomaba de la tierra. {acorn:face happy} {squirrel:face surprised} ¡Era Bellota! {tree:face happy} El viejo {tree:enter} árbol {tree:glow} susurró con orgullo. [softly] Así empecé yo, dijo, hace muchísimo tiempo.
